title: Small dashboard fixes, less unnecessary scrolling
summary:
A quiet maintenance day: cleaner key management, properly named CSVs, and a refreshed GPT-5.2 connection.

The API keys table is now more compact and no longer traps people in a scrolling panel. CSV downloads also expose their filenames correctly across CORS, because a downloaded file should not arrive as a small administrative mystery.

GPT-5.2 now points at the Sweden Central endpoint, keeping the model connection current.

The daily Instagram post landed alongside the product maintenance.
